summary: Iteration 25 - Demo Account Mode Feature Testing. Comprehensive backend and frontend testing of the new demo mode feature. All 17 backend tests passed (registration with demo/real modes, profile endpoint, mode switching, demo data seeding, is_demo filtering, delete protection, onboarding tour endpoints). All 10 frontend tests passed (demo banner, capital badge, mode toggle, restart tour, DEMO badges on strategies, onboarding tour auto-trigger, paper trades section).

integration_issues.issue: Mode switch does window.location.reload() which clears auth state (stored in React state, not localStorage). User gets logged out after mode switch. This is a known limitation from previous iterations.

passed_tests: BACKEND: POST /api/v1/auth/register with start_demo=true creates demo account
BACKEND: POST /api/v1/auth/register with start_demo=false creates real account
BACKEND: GET /api/v1/account/profile returns account_mode, demo_capital, has_completed_onboarding
BACKEND: POST /api/v1/account/switch-mode {mode:'real'} switches to real mode
BACKEND: POST /api/v1/account/switch-mode {mode:'demo'} switches to demo mode
BACKEND: Demo user has 3 seeded strategies (golden_cross, rsi_reversion, supertrend)
BACKEND: Demo user has 1 seeded paper trade with 5 completed trades
BACKEND: POST /api/v1/account/activate-demo activates demo mode and seeds data
BACKEND: Activate-demo is idempotent (calling twice still results in 3 demo strategies)
BACKEND: GET /api/v1/strategies in demo mode returns only is_demo=true strategies
BACKEND: GET /api/v1/strategies in real mode returns only is_demo!=true strategies
BACKEND: DELETE demo-seeded strategy returns 403 (demo_tag strategies protected)
BACKEND: New demo user has has_completed_onboarding=false
BACKEND: POST /api/v1/account/complete-onboarding sets flag to true
BACKEND: POST /api/v1/account/restart-tour sets flag back to false
BACKEND: testai@example.com (real user) can login and access profile
BACKEND: demouser1@example.com (demo user) can login and is in demo mode
FRONTEND: Register page has 'Start Free Demo' (primary) and 'Create Account' (secondary) buttons
FRONTEND: Demo user dashboard shows demo banner with 'DEMO MODE ₹10,450 virtual capital'
FRONTEND: Sidebar shows Demo Capital badge with ₹10,450 and trades count
FRONTEND: Sidebar shows 'Demo Mode' toggle button
FRONTEND: Sidebar shows 'Restart Tour' button for demo users
FRONTEND: Dashboard shows 3 demo strategies with DEMO badges
FRONTEND: Onboarding tour auto-triggers on first demo login
FRONTEND: Paper trades section shows demo paper trade (INFY +4.55%)
FRONTEND: Demo banner has 'Switch to Real' link
FRONTEND: Real user (testai@example.com) sees no demo banner, no demo badge, 'Real Mode' toggle
action_items: OPTIONAL: Consider persisting auth token to localStorage to survive page reloads (would fix mode switch logout issue)
critical_code_review_comments: Demo data seeding is properly idempotent - calling activate-demo multiple times doesn't duplicate data
is_demo filtering correctly uses $ne:True to include legacy strategies without the field in real mode
demo_tag field correctly protects seeded strategies from deletion
Onboarding tour uses react-joyride with proper styling and auto-triggers for new demo users
Mode switch updates backend DB correctly but frontend reload clears auth state (known limitation)
seed_data_creation: Multiple test users created during pytest run (test_demo_*, test_profile_*, test_seed_*, etc.)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 25 tested the new Demo Account Mode feature. All backend APIs work correctly: registration with start_demo flag, profile endpoint, mode switching, demo data seeding (3 strategies, 1 paper trade, 1 backtest record), is_demo filtering, delete protection for demo_tag strategies, and onboarding tour endpoints. Frontend correctly shows demo banner, capital badge, mode toggle, restart tour button, DEMO badges on strategies, and auto-triggers onboarding tour. Known limitation: mode switch does page reload which clears auth state (not persisted to localStorage). Demo users: demouser1@example.com, demoscreenshot@example.com. Real user: testai@example.com with 24 strategies.
